title: OpenDana metasprites and animation (graphics/sprites/*.json)
description: The sprite bundles of the package: the Hero metasprites, the steam poses and the animated background CHR bank tables. It is a lossless view of the extracted pose and effect tables (MJ2). A part is (dx, dy, tile, palette); a pose is (bank, address, part_count, part_index, ?) as extracted. The exact meaning of each column is fixed by the extractor and the compose.c consumer.

world_sprite_banks.description: Sprite CHR bank per world (indices 0..9 for worlds 1..10).

pose_parts.description: Flat part table; each part is (dx, dy, tile, palette).

bg_banks.description: Animated background CHR bank sequence per slot.

bg_waits.description: Hold time of each entry of bg_banks.
